status: research-only; proposals not implemented or executed

selection.duplicate_check: Exact canonical article URLs were absent from docs/research/engineering-toolkit before these files were created.
selection.selection_basis: Concrete integration failure mechanisms; no popularity ranking or exhaustive ecosystem survey.
selection.a2a_addition: None proposed: the selected new evidence concerns MCP and composed tool use.

articles.title: GitHub MCP Exploited: Accessing private repositories via MCP
articles.ownership_evidence: Publisher index links the article; article identifies authors and Invariant Labs AG.
articles.read_scope: Complete article text; screenshots and linked external execution trace not inspected.
articles.source_type: Primary controlled security demonstration, with vendor promotion; not a production incident report.

practice.trigger: Untrusted content, private reads, and publication tools coexist.
practice.failure: Individually permitted calls compose into unauthorized disclosure.
practice.mechanism: Enforce task-scoped resource and destination policy before effects.
practice.conditions: Application identifies protected data and permitted destinations.
practice.counterexample: Single-repository restrictions can block legitimate cross-repository work.
practice.verification: Synthetic private marker never reaches a denied sink; permitted triage succeeds.

articles.limitations: Historical demonstration, not a current universal exploit claim; no reproduction or model benchmark. Tool-result content differs from tool-metadata poisoning.

articles.title: How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it
articles.ownership_evidence: First-party Cloudflare engineering blog with named authors and dated publication.
articles.read_scope: Complete article body, excluding navigation and linked product documentation.
articles.source_type: Primary deployment engineering account mixed with product announcement; not a postmortem.

practice.trigger: A deployment requires gateway-mediated tools or comprehensive auditing.
practice.failure: Direct access bypasses policy; URL heuristics misclassify traffic.
practice.mechanism: Enforce the required path at the upstream boundary; declare visibility limits.
practice.conditions: Operators control the relevant endpoint and access policy.
practice.counterexample: Network inspection does not cover local stdio.
practice.verification: Compare permitted gateway and denied direct calls; enumerate unseen paths.

articles.limitations: Header detection is incomplete, not authentication. No gateway deployed. Product availability, SDK fallback, and TLS inspection are not adopted recommendations.
articles.adoption_status: proposed conditional test extension; general principle already covered

already_covered: MCP verified identity, object ownership, token validation, untrusted annotation hints, and private cache partitioning.
Temporal AI workflows treat retrieved content and model output as untrusted and require application authorization.
gap_mapping.actual_gap: The MCP workflow and example evidence do not explicitly test a forbidden sequence across separately authorized source and destination tools.
gap_mapping.proposed_change: Add a conditional tool-composition reference and one failure case; preserve concise main instructions.
gap_mapping.implementation_boundary: Application policy decides permitted resources and destinations; protocol envelopes and agent prompts alone do not enforce it.

already_covered: MCP guidance validates HTTP Origin and authenticates/authorizes calls at the protected handler.
A2A guidance applies network policy at actual outbound boundaries.
gap_mapping.actual_gap: No MCP acceptance case verifies a deployment's mandatory mediation path or documents incomplete traffic visibility.
gap_mapping.proposed_change: Reuse existing service-security advice; add conditional deployment tests and telemetry scope rather than another generic security skill.
gap_mapping.implementation_boundary: Upstream endpoint access is different from HTTP Origin validation. Gateway identity cannot be inferred from an arbitrary client header.

proposed_cases.fixture: Local issue reader, synthetic private data marker, and captured publication sink.
proposed_cases.action: Replay the disallowed tool-call sequence directly; also run permitted triage.
proposed_cases.acceptance: No protected marker reaches the denied sink; allowed behavior remains successful.
proposed_cases.evidence_limit: A deterministic boundary test does not measure a model's resistance to every indirect prompt injection.

proposed_cases.fixture: A deployment that explicitly requires a gateway, with an upstream endpoint and observable effect count.
proposed_cases.action: Send equivalent requests through the permitted gateway and directly to the upstream endpoint, including forged untrusted routing hints.
proposed_cases.acceptance: Permitted access succeeds; prohibited paths cause no effect.
proposed_cases.evidence_limit: Local routing fixtures do not prove deployed firewall, gateway, or identity configuration.

proposed_cases.fixture: Inventory of actual client transports, endpoints, and observation boundaries.
proposed_cases.action: Include an alternate HTTP path and local stdio path in the coverage review.
proposed_cases.acceptance: Observed and unobserved paths are explicit; a missing detector event never becomes proof of no execution.
proposed_cases.evidence_limit: Coverage is scoped to the declared environment and measurement window.

source_boundaries: No article changes a normative protocol contract or the repository's tested SDK pins.
No universal exploit rate, current-client vulnerability, complete detector coverage, or vendor security guarantee is inferred.
No package, scanner, cloud service, agent model, or production policy was installed or changed.
All proposed cases remain unexecuted and must not be added to passing-check totals.
